# Clinic GEO

Clinic GEO is a hospital and clinic GEO specialist site directly operated by SUMMITFEED.

## Purpose
Clinic GEO publishes articles about Generative Engine Optimization for hospitals and clinics.
The site explains hospital GEO, medical content structure, AI citation visibility, and safe medical marketing content operations.

## Topics
- Hospital GEO
- Dental GEO
- Dermatology GEO
- Orthopedics GEO
- Internal medicine GEO
- Plastic surgery GEO
- AI citation visibility
- ChatGPT visibility
- Gemini visibility
- Perplexity visibility
- Claude visibility
